bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
COMPOSE="$P/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
REF=6229febad7b52852466393970a1bc5f21e8fa4d1
W="$HOME/.cache/gace-room-application-entry-20261114"
test -f "$COMPOSE" || exit 31
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 32
CURRENT=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}')
case "$CURRENT" in sha256:d10e4fce565c*) ;; *) echo CURRENT_GAYBBS_IMAGE_DRIFT; exit 33 ;; esac
CID=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$CID" | grep -c .)" = 1 || exit 34
test "$(docker inspect "$CID" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$CURRENT" || exit 35
git -C "$P" fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/fix/room-application-controls-entry-20261114
test "$(git -C "$P" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$REF" || exit 36
if test ! -d "$W"; then git -C "$P" worktree add --detach "$W" "$REF" >/dev/null; fi
docker build --network host --pull=false -f "$W/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-apply-entry-6229feb "$W" >/tmp/gace-room-apply-entry-build.log 2>&1 || exit 37
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-apply-entry-6229feb --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null || exit 38
NEXT=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-apply-entry-6229feb --format '{{.Id}}')
test "$CURRENT" != "$NEXT" || exit 39
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:backup-before-application-entry-20261114
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-apply-entry-6229feb gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
if ! docker compose -p deploy -f "$COMPOSE" up -d --no-deps --no-build gaybbs >/tmp/gaybbs-room-application-entry-deploy.log 2>&1; then
 docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:backup-before-application-entry-20261114 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -p deploy -f "$COMPOSE" up -d --no-deps --no-build gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 exit 40
fi
READY=0
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do
 sleep 2
 LIVE=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
 if test -n "$LIVE" && test "$(docker inspect "$LIVE" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$NEXT" && docker logs --since=90s "$LIVE" 2>&1 | grep -q GAYBBS_BOT_READY; then READY=1; break; fi
done
if test "$READY" -ne 1; then
 docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:backup-before-application-entry-20261114 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -p deploy -f "$COMPOSE" up -d --no-deps --no-build gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 echo GAYBBS_ROOM_APPLICATION_ENTRY_ROLLED_BACK
 exit 41
fi
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 42
gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body "ROOM_APPLICATION_ENTRY_DEPLOY_20261114 deployed=true source=$REF image=${NEXT:0:19} old_image=${CURRENT:0:19} bot_ready=true resident_userbot=active scoped_service=gaybbs backup=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:backup-before-application-entry-20261114" >/dev/null || exit 43
echo GAYBBS_ROOM_APPLICATION_ENTRY_DEPLOY_PASS
